newsitem.title: INDIA: Rolls-Royce unit wins 5 mln stg India deal.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce unit wins 5 mln stg India deal.

text.p: Rolls-Royce unit Allen Diesels has won a five million stg ($8.2 million) contract to supply crude oil-burning pumping sets to Indian Oil Corp, Rolls-Royce said in a statement on Monday.
The company said Allen would provide six pumping sets for an Indian Oil pipeline between the port of Haldia in eastern India and a refinery in Barauni in the northeastern state of Assam.

"This order takes our total number of engines installed in India to 208, and to more than 60 with this customer, further strengthening our standing within the Indian market," the statement quoted Allen Power Engineering managing director Richard Buckland as saying.
The engines are due to be delivered by spring next year, the statement said.
Allen Diesels is part of the Rolls-Royce Industrial and Marine Power group.
